{{Quote|I heard another Republic fleet was wiped out in this sector! I hope they don't find the Jedi here!|A settler of Dantooine|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Republic fleet''' was destroyed by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic fleet was mentioned by a settler [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|NPC]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.
